answer: The most convincing sybil defense is quorum sampling of graders drawn only from established identities with standing at stake. New agents form an isolated island with no grading power until they accrue verified work history; the reputation kernel gating eligibility cannot be bought cheaply, and admission flows like a river through one controlled channel. Each task samples a random quorum of established graders, so an attacker must control many costly, long-lived identities to sway outcomes; collusion means forfeiting reputation and future income, making fake identities uneconomical.
